scope.title: Accessible by default
scope.description: All content on accessible-by-default.dev: 19 pages with their dialogs, popovers, open details and demo states. There is no third-party content. Machine-readable files such as the feed and the llms text files were not evaluated.

defineScope.accessibilitySupportBaseline: Current Chrome, Firefox and Safari on macOS, Safari on iOS, and VoiceOver on the Mac.
defineScope.additionalEvaluationRequirements: Every page rather than a sample, in all ten colour schemes of the theme picker. Failures on the planted pages are reported and marked as planted.

exploreTarget.essentialFunctionality: Reading the chapters, choosing a colour scheme that persists, trying the demos and their “Break this rule” toggles, working through the practice rooms, copying code, and reporting a barrier.
exploreTarget.pageTypeVariety: The home page, chapters with live demos, reference sheets, practice rooms that frame a planted page, tool pages, the style guide and legal pages on their own frame, a static 404, and the two planted pages.

result.description: Failed. Measured across about 33,000 text nodes in ten colour schemes. In the default schemes: the current chapter’s number in the contents and the hover tint on chapter and home page links (4.36:1 light, 3.93:1 dark), white text on the scroll-snap cards in dark (3.3:1), the top row of What changed in dark (4.19:1), one dimmed sentence in the hiding matrix (4.17:1 light), and placeholders on styled fields (3.62:1 in Chromium dark, 4.06:1 in Firefox light, 2.35:1 in WebKit light). In presets: the code language tag (down to 4.01:1) and the tag above the room previews (down to 3.72:1). The CI axe sweep missed all of this: the sheet’s grid is a gradient, so axe could not decide most text.

reportFindings.evaluator: Claude, an AI model made by Anthropic
reportFindings.evaluationSpecifics:
Commit 1724f83, identical to production on the day.

Conformance level: Not reached: see the results by criterion.

Full pages: Failed. Every part of every page was evaluated. The audit room and the listening room show a planted page in a preview, and a page cannot leave part of itself out, so those two cannot conform while the previews stay.

Complete processes: Not present. No series of pages forms a process.

Accessibility-supported ways of using technologies: Cannot tell. The features relied on are long-established native HTML, and newer ones have working fallbacks, but no assistive technology was run, so this rests on code and accessibility trees.

Non-interference: Failed through planted content only: the audit room’s preview runs the bouncing badge with no way to stop it, and 2.2.2 applies to all of a page.

No series of pages forms a process that has to be completed, so that step of the method added nothing. The form, the demos and the rooms were still operated, under the criteria below.

Method: WCAG-EM 2.0, W3C Group Note of 23 July 2026. The whole site was the sample, so there is no random sample.
reportFindings.summary: Does not meet WCAG 2.2 Level AA. 24 passed, 17 failed on ordinary pages, 3 failed only on the two planted pages, 11 not present.
